Commentary.Commentary: If Bumrah wasn't enough of a threat on his own, the hosts had to deal with Shami, Ishant and Jadeja and all of them created problems for every single batsman. If ever there was a complete performance, this is it. India have decided they WON'T ENFORCE THE FOLLOW-ON! Now, they have mammoth lead of 292 runs, but there is forecast of rain for both Day 4 and 5. So, there's a good chance India would like to add runs quickly and come out to bowl again. Mostly likely it will be tomorrow itself. Let's see how this goes.

A fine, fine bowling display from the no.1 Test team in the world. The Indians have bowled out Australia for just 151 runs. Jasprit Bumrah was the star of the show as he picked up a 6-wicket haul, running through the Australian batting order with his deadly pace and clever variations. None of the Australian batsmen were able to put up a fight. When you're going after 443 in the first innings, if you don't have a single 50-run partnership, that's just not going to cut it at all.

OUT! That's that. AUSTRALIA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 151 in their first dig. Bumrah picks up his sixth and Hazlewood goes out without troubling the scorers. Fuller length on middle and leg, too pacy for the tailender. Goes off the inside edge and on to his pads. The ball then rolls on to disturb the stumps and knock the bails down. Bumrah finishes with 6/33. India have a lead of 292 to play with. Will they come out to bat here or will they put the hosts in again? We will have to wait and see. For now, we see Hanuma Vihari rushing into the dressing room, giving us a slight hint that India might bat again and give their bowlers some rest.
Short ball aimed at the head, Josh tries to ramp it but misses the ball completely.
Outside off on a length, Hazlewood taps it down.
Josh Hazlewood is the last batsman to the crease.

OUT! Struck in front and the umpire raises his finger immediately! Bumrah has five. His 3rd fifer in Tests. Incredible considering he made his debut earlier this year. Pacy yorker length ball that Lyon tries to flick but misses. Get rapped low on the pads in front of middle and leg, the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger here. Replays show that the ball would have gone on to clip leg stump.
FOUR BYES! Bouncer down leg and the ball is too wayward as even Pant cannot reach it and it runs away to the fence. 150 runs up for the hosts.
Beaten! Outside off and the drift on this ball takes it away from the left-handed Starc. He is looking to drive this full ball and misses it due to the drift in the end.
Shorter outside off, Mitch stands tall and pushes it back.
Flatter ball on middle, pushed towards mid on by the batsman.
Fuller outside off, defended onto the ground.
Another ball that is flat and on off, Starc comes ahead and dead-bats it.
Flatter ball outside off, played back with a straight bat.
Another ball on a length and on top of off stump, kept out well by Nathan.
Short length ball on middle, defended from within the crease.
Bouncer first up. Going down leg and Lyon just ducks under it.
Nathan Lyon walks in at number 10, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Caught behind! The skipper has to go. Pouched beautifully by Pant behind. It is a length ball just outside off and there is a slight hint of reverse swing here that takes the ball away from the right-hander at the last moment. Paine who is looking to push it down on the off side gets an outside edge that just about carries into the waiting gloves of Pant. Good catch moving to his right and Australia are eight down now, with still 97 runs to avoid the follow-on.
Fuller ball on the pads, slight reverse swing. Mitch flicks it away to square leg for a single.
Short of a length ball on off stump and comes in slightly, Starc is done in by the pace and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Jasprit Bumrah with the ball in hand.
Fuller outside off, driven to the cover fielder.
Slower through the air, Tim comes down the wicket and pushes it back down the ground.
Quicker this time on off, Paine comes ahead to defend but the ball goes off the thick inside edge towards square leg.
Flighted outside off, Paine lets the ball go through.
Flatter ball at the pads, played with soft hands to short leg.
Looped up outside off but very full and Starc pushes it down to long on for a single.
Welcome back for the final session of play on Day 3. The players and umpires stroll into their positions. Mitchell Starc will take strike on the first ball after resumption. Jadeja to bowl.
... Third Day, Evening Session ...

India firmly in control of this Boxing Day Test. Another session which belongs to them. Australia have lost 3 wickets in the 30 overs, scoring only 56 runs. They lost Head, the younger Marsh and Cummins, to some extraordinary bowling from the Indian contingent. Bumrah, Jadeja and Shami all have done their part to put the hosts on the back foot. Tim Paine is out there and he'll have to bat with the tail. Starc is partnering him for the moment, who can obviously bat, but the task is a monumental one. The Aussies need 99 runs to avoid the follow-on and that will be the first and only thing on the home side's mind right now. Let's see if they're able to do that. Join us in some time for the last session of the day.
Probably the last ball before Tea. Outside off and on a length. Paine keeps it out watchfully. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 3.
Another one angling in on middle and leg, flicked away by Paine in the gap behind square on the leg side. Couple taken.
Fuller ball at the pads, flicked away to the deep square leg fielder for a single.

EDGED AND FOUR! Wide outside off, Starc goes fishing. Gets an outside edge that does not quite carry to Kohli at a wide fourth slip. The ball takes a bounce in front of him awkwardly and runs under towards the third man fence for a boundary.

Loud appeal! On a length and angling down on the pads, Starc goes for the flick and misses the ball. The ball raps him on the front pad and the Indians are up in a huge appeal. The ball seems to be going down leg here. Shami and Kohli have a huge discussion before deciding not to go upstairs. Replays show that the ball would have gone on to clip leg stump. But the decision from the umpire would have prevailed.
Around the wicket, short length ball outside off, Starc pushes this towards mid-wicket.
Straighter one on middle and leg, wristed away on the leg side.
Minimal turn on this occasion, Tim lets it come to him before blocking it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quick, flat and turning away from outside off, Paine is unable to connect with the ball.
Quicker through the air and around off, Paine defends it out from the front foot.
On the stumps, it's driven straight back.
Mitchell Starc is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Shami strikes on his return to the attack. A promising stand of 36 is broken. He charges in and attacks the stumps with a length ball around off, it nips back in and goes right through Pat Cummins' defense. Nothing he could do about it, was just too good. Australia lose another wicket. They need another 106 runs to avoid the follow-on.
Full in length and on the stumps, driven to mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fraction straight in line, worked off the pads on the leg side for a single.

Not out! Paine survives as the height saves him. Not a bad review in all honesty, looked close to the naked eye. Shami lands this length ball on middle and off and it nips in slightly, catches Paine on the pads and an appeal goes up. The umpire shakes his head. Kohli is the closest to the batsman excluding the bowler, so he thinks long and hard and eventually, takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and show it to be going over the stumps. India lose the review.
Review taken. It's for an lbw decision against Tim Paine. Looks close. Let's see...
Ouch! That's got to hurt! Shami comes in and shapes it into the batsman, Tim Paine is beaten past the inside edge and caught on the box. He takes a moment to recover.
Mohammed Shami is back into the attack.
Another ball on middle stump, Cummins drives it back towards mid on.
Flatter ball on the stumps, kept out watchfully.
Slower outside the off stump, the batsman looks to drive but the ball goes off the inside half back to the bowler.
Well down the leg side, Cummins goes after it but doesn't connect.
Flatter ball on off, Pat comes ahead and dead-bats this.
FOUR! Amazing timing on this one! Flighted outside off, Cummins drives this beautifully for a boundary through the covers.
Touch short and outside off, Cummins goes back, opens the face and punches it square towards point for a run.
Full in length and outside off, it's driven sweetly through the covers for a couple of runs.

If Australia can't get to the intended number, then there's a good chance that India can enforce the follow-on. The weather isn't as hot as the previous two days and India haven't bowled as many overs to feel really tired. Will be interesting to see what Virat Kohli opts to do if faced with the situation.
Pitches it on a length and around off, Pat with a solid block from within his crease.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked straight to the man at square leg.
Serves it in the channel outside off, on a good length, Cummins plays and misses.
Shortens the length on this occasion, around off, kept out with the full face.
Quick, flat and darted on the stumps, The Australian captain keeps it out safely.
Floats it up just outside off, Paine is well forward in defense.
A little slower through the air, around off, kept out off the front foot.
Quite full again, it's wristed just wide of mid on. The batsmen take off and complete the run with ease.
Darted full on the stumps, it's driven back down the track to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Throws this too far outside off, left alone.
Full and attacking the stumps, looking for the reverse, Tim drives it to mid on.
Length delivery in the channel outside off, Paine attempts to put bat on ball but misses.
Some problem with the ball it seems. The umpire checks the shape, puts the ball through the hoops and it looks okay. We are fine to continue with the same one.
Too straight in line, worked to the man in the mid-wicket area once again.
Fires it full and angles it in on middle and leg, Paine flicks it to mid-wicket but finds the fielder there.
Full and fast on the stumps, worked in front of square leg to end the over.
Full and straight, it's hit back to the bowler.
FOUR! Some nice drift in as Jadeja comes from a bit wide of the crease but Cummins puts this away. Drives it square as he has room to free his arms and finds the fence without any problem.
Quick, full and straight, driven to the cover fielder.
A bit slower through the air, drifting in on middle and leg, clipped to short fine leg for no run.
Full and darted in on middle and leg, eased down to long on for one run.
Change of ends for Ravindra Jadeja.
Fullish in length and attacking the off stump, it's driven back down the track.
Wide! Another bumper, wide outside off this time, the batsman arches back and lets it go. Wide called for height.
Length delivery on middle and leg, a little too straight in line and this allows Paine to move inside the line and work it behind square leg for a single.
Brings the short one out of nowhere, hits the deck hard. Paine though remains watchful as he ducks and evades.
Too far outside off on this occasion, the Australian skipper doesn't bother himself with it.
Again on a length, close to off this time, Paine gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Paine looks to cut but gets it off the inner half to gully.
Ishant Sharma is called back on.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and blocks it out.
Quick single, nicely done. Good running between the wickets. Paine taps this to mid off and takes off. Pujara is the man there, he has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Drives it along the turf to covers but straight to the fielder.
Some flight on this as Vihari lands it around off, Tim Paine is well forward in defense.
No turn on this occasion, Paine watches the ball closely and lets it go past him.
Floats it on off stump, kept out from the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Cummins pushes it away from his body but straight to the fielder.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Keeps it around off this time, it is defended.
Stifled appeal, but going down leg. Was never going to be given. Sliding in on leg, going further down, Cummins is caught on the pads as he tries to play at it.
Fuller in length from Jadeja, a defensive blade is presented in response.
Spinning away from outside off, Pat makes an easy leave.
Fuller and around off, defended solidly to end the over.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman yet again.
Short, flat and just outside off, the Aussie captain is on the back foot once more to defend it down the track.
Slightly short and around off, Paine positions himself behind the line and defends.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, another defensive shot presented by the batsman.
Tosses it right up there, on off stump, Paine shows the full face and defends it out.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, Pat drives it through the gap in the covers and takes three runs for it.
Yorker darted in on middle, it's drilled towards the mid on fielder.
Drops this on the leg side and crosses over.
Paine moves inside the line and works this in front of square leg. Gets two comfortably.
Full and straight on the stumps, met with the full face of the bat.
Change of ends for Ravindra Jadeja.
Loopy and full outside off, Cummins throws his bat at it and misses.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.
Tossed up off break outside off, pushed into the covers for no run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and on the off stump, blocked solidly.

Dropped! Vihari could have had a wicket with his very first ball in this Test. Bowls the straighter one outside off, Cummins comes forward to play for the turn and ends up getting an outside edge. It goes behind to Pant who gets low but can't get a hold of it.

Drinks break in the afternoon session. 2 wickets in the past hour and India firmly on top here. Pat Cummins who has done well in the bat this series so far has joined hands with his skipper. They will have to stitch a big stand for Australia to first avoid follow on and then, think about getting close to India's first innings score. Can they do so? Also, Hanuma Vihari is into the attack.
Slightly slower outside off, pushed to cover with soft hands.
Shorter length ball outside off, defended from within the crease.

FOUR! What has happened here? Outside off and Paine decides to leave the ball late after initially coming ahead to defend but the ball is quick and goes off the under part of the bat between slip and gully for a boundary. Welcome runs for the hosts courtesy some indecision by their skipper.
Length ball served on middle and leg, Paine keeps it out back down the ground.
Fuller length on off, Tim pushes it to mid on.
Length ball outside off, Paine defends the ball onto the ground.
Ishant Sharma returns.
Slower outside off, a front foot defense follows.
Another one on middle and leg that Cummins pushes to mid on.
Fuller length ball, Paine pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, defended towards cover.
Flatter through the air on middle, Pat comes ahead to defend but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat wide of short leg for a single.
Slower through the air and on off stump, kept out watchfully.
Fuller in length, Cummins works it down to fine leg and gets to the other end, retaining strike.
On middle and leg, Cummins has got a good defense to this one.
On a length and this one shapes slightly away from the right-hander, Paine drops this on the off side with soft hands and runs through for a quick single.
Length ball shaping in slightly after landing, the skipper defends it back down the ground.
Short one outside off, Tim sways out of the way and lets the ball fly.
Going down leg and Paine lets it go through to the keeper.
Drifting down on the pads, Tim keeps strike with a single worked down to fine leg.
Flatter outside off, defended off the front foot showing the full face of the bat.
Flighted one on middle, the batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it back to Jadeja.
Quicker and coming in with the angle, Paine stands tall and pushes it back to mid on.
Another one on off and middle, defended safely back down the ground.
Slower through the air on middle, Paine defends towards mid on.
Length ball on off stump coming in slightly, Cummins blocks it out.
On the pads, the skipper flicks it away towards fine leg for a single.
Another bouncer! This time, Tim ducks under the ball and lets it go through.
Ouch! Shami goes for a bouncer and the ball does not rise much. Paine looking to duck under the ball gets hit on the shoulder. Looks fine to continue though.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked away to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
On a length outside off, Paine defends towards the off side.
Flatter one on middle, Cummins comes ahead and defends the ball onto the ground.
Slower outside off, kept out again towards the cover-point fielder.
Fired in outside off, Cummins keeps it out towards point.
Pat Cummins is in at number 8, replacing Mitchell Marsh.

OUT! Caught at slip! Off the outside edge and gone straight to Rahane. Fuller ball on leg, Marsh looks to whip-flick it away through mid-wicket. Unfortunately for him, the ball takes the leading edge and lobs up to Rahane for an easy catch. The ball was drifting all along till now but on this one, it takes the rough and causes a big deviation instead of going straight down. Probably what caused Mitch to get an outside edge instead of comfortably whipping it away for a boundary. Six down now. A follow-on looks definitely on the cards here, especially considering not too many overs have been bowled so far and the conditions today are not as hot as the previous two days have been.
Flatter and aimed at off stump, Marsh stands tall and punches it back to the bowler.
Slower one outside off, Paine pushes this towards cover-point for a single.
Fuller length ball driven to mid on and the over is brought to an end. Maiden.
Short length ball outside off, Mitch defends from within the crease.
Bouncer! Slightly down the leg side, Marsh sways out of the way.
On the middle stump, Marsh pushes this back down the ground to mid on.
Going down leg and Marsh cannot connect his willow on this one as he tries to flick this ball.
Fuller outside off, Marsh drives to the left of mid off but for no run.
A solid defense from the Aussie skipper to end this over. It was a full ball on middle.
Flatter ball outside off, the batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Shorter one, Tim cuts this but finds Ishant at backward point moving slightly to his left to stop this.

Seeing the batsman come down, Jadeja slightly pulls his length back. While trying to push the ball onto the leg side, Paine gets it on the inside half and onto the pads towards short leg. Mayank fumbles, else could have been a run out chance.
Looped up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on middle, Paine dead-bats it.
Fuller length ball to end the over, Mitch gets his front leg out of the way and drives the ball towards mid on.

FOUR! Never mind Marsh struggling here, he has just bludgeoned this short one off the back foot and over mid-wicket for a boundary. Right off the middle of the bat. Cracking shot! The 100 comes up for the Aussies.
Another one that comes in, Mitchell Marsh isn't looking too comfortable there as he misses his flick once more to get hit on the pads. Again going down.
This one comes in with the angle and Marsh misses his flick to get rapped on the pad. The ball seems to be going down leg hence the umpire says no when the Indians appeal.
Wide outside off and swinging slightly away, Mitchell goes for an expansive drive but the ball goes off the inner half and towards mid off. Looks like some reverse swing there.
Length ball outside off, Marsh stands tall and pushes the ball to cover.
Mohammed Shami replaces Jasprit Bumrah.
Another full one, the Aussie skipper drives this to cover.
Fuller ball outside off, Tim comes ahead and defends it towards cover.
A bit more air on this one, Paine stands tall and watches it as he pushes it towards cover.
Flatter ball on middle, keeps a bit low. Paine does well to bring his bat down in time and keep it out.
Short ball on middle, Marsh whips this away through mid-wicket and gets three till the ball is returned.
Flatter ball on middle, kept out off the front foot.

What was Marsh thinking there? Short ball and instinctively Mitchell goes for the pull. Goes off the top edge and nowhere in control. Luckily for the hosts, the ball lands short of Shami at fine leg who is charging in for the catch. Single taken.
This one seems to have moved away slightly after landing. The batsman pushes this ball away to the cover region.
Full, almost yorker length. Marsh does really well to dig this one out.
Another length ball outside off, Mitchell defends it back down the ground off the back foot.
Length ball coming in slightly after landing, Marsh is ahead as he pushes this one to mid on off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Paine gets off the mark with a shot played with soft hands towards the point region.
Lovely. Nice drift in from Jadeja, it's tossed up around off. Marsh comes half forward and blocks it out.
Good stop from Kohli. Marsh drives this full delivery to the covers where the Indian skipper makes a diving stop.
Short and flat close to off, kept out from the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sliding in from around off, full in length, Marsh defends with a straight bat.
Full and outside off, driven to the man at cover.
Fuller in length to end the over, driven down the ground.
Length ball on middle to start off to Paine, he works it to mid-wicket with soft hands.
Tim Paine is in at number 7, replacing Travis Head.

OUT! Timberrrrr! Done in by sheer pace here. Completely cleaned up and Head has to depart. Half the team back in the shed for just 92. Fuller length delivery from around the wicket, angling in. Head was bogged down, looks to go for a shot straight down the ground and gets the inside edge as he is beaten for pace. The ball goes on to knock the middle and leg stump. The Indians are elated, just the start they would have wanted after the Lunch break. Bumrah has his third. The Aussies are in deep trouble now.
Marsh is off the mark as he pushes this ball on off towards cover and gets to the other end.
Keeps a bit low yet again, from a length. Mitchell Marsh who is looking to defend is beaten on the inside and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Length ball just outside off, Marsh comes ahead and defends the ball onto the ground.
Flatter delivery outside off and comes in after landing, TH stays back in his crease and keeps it out.
Almost! The ball keeps low but Head stays low and gets his bat down in time. Was outside off and turned onto the pads. The southpaw gets the ball off the inside edge and onto his pads.
The batsman comes ahead and dead-bats this.
Another ball that is just outside off on a good length, Travis comes ahead slightly before pushing the ball away.
Flatter ball outside off, Head comes ahead and keeps the ball out.
Flatter ball outside off, Head pushes it off the back foot to mid on.
Another full delivery that Marsh keeps out towards mid on.

LOUD APPEAL! But the umpire says no. Was full and fast but just going down leg maybe. Marsh who was looking to flick the ball missed it and got rapped on the pads but the ball was missing leg stump hence he was safe.
Shorter outside off, the batsman plays it to point off the back foot and gets to the other end.
Length ball outside off, Head pushes it to cover off the back foot.
Yorker length ball on middle, Travis keeps it out towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Head drives it to mid off.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Flatter and full on middle to end the over, Marsh stays ahead to push the ball back to the bowler.
Another one bang on target, Marsh defends comfortably though.
Quicker and darted in on middle, Marsh pushes it back to Jadeja with a straight bat.
Going down leg, Marsh leaves it alone.
First run of the session, Head pushes this fuller one through cover for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off to start, Head stays back and defends.

Welcome back, folks. The players and umpires are making their way to the middle for the second session. Mitchell Marsh will join Travis Head out there. Head will face the first ball of the session, to be bowled by Ravindra Jadeja.
... Third Day, Afternoon Session ...

Post that, Ravindra Jadeja, who was brought on, didn't disappoint as he got the important wicket of Usman Khawaja soon and just when it looked like the hosts would go into Lunch three down, Jasprit Bumrah bamboozled Shaun Marsh on the last ball before the break to get him LBW plumb in front. The hosts are 89/4 and will be desperate for some sort of a stand, but the Indian bowlers seem to be on fire at the moment. Can the Aussies fight back in the second session or will the visitors run havoc? Join us for the post-Lunch session in some time. It is all happening here, you wouldn't want to miss it.

India's session no doubt! 81 runs have been scored in 27 overs at 3 rpo but 4 wickets have been taken by India. The visitors will definitely go into the Lunch break the happier team. The Aussies started the day off at 8/0 and with some good strokes from the openers who were looking to stitch a decent partnership but against the run of play, brilliant captaincy brought about the downfall of Aaron Finch. Poor shot making saw his partner, Marcus Harris, depart and India were suddenly right on top.

OUT! What a delivery! Completely outfoxes Marsh. Hasn't used the slower one much this series and brings it out when Shaun would least expect it. Bumrah comes around the wicket and disguises this slower ball brilliantly. The southpaw who was looking to defend this one and get to the break is early into the shot and misses the ball. Gets rapped low on his pads and right in front of the stumps. The umpire has no qualms in raising his fingers. The elder Marsh sibling has a chat with his partner but in the end just walks off without reviewing. Australia have lost their fourth wicket and THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 3.
Fuller length ball outside off, Marsh watches the ball through into the gloves of the keeper.
Shaun lets this ball go outside his off stump again.
Tad outside off, Marsh shoulders arms to this ball.
A confident looking defense to this length ball on off stump.
Outside off, left alone by Marsh.
Good defensive stroke to end the over from Head.
Flatter quicker delivery outside off, Marsh drives this wide of mid on using his feet. Quick single taken as Rohit dives to his right and stops this one.
Outside off and an arm ball, no stroke offered.
Oooh! Grip and turn once more. Gives this air outside off and the ball turns enough to beat the inside edge of Marsh who is looking to defend. Too much bounce and turn though.
Very full, almost yorker length. SM digs it out towards mid-wicket.
Looped outside off, Marsh uses his feet and drives towards mid on.
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards cover who misfields it slightly but mid off has the ball covered hence there is no single.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the back foot to mid off.
Fuller this time on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Quick and just outside off but the ball straightens, the batsman leaves the ball alone.
Keeps slightly low this one! Length ball outside off, Head goes to cut but misses the ball completely.
Length ball outside off, Head stands tall and defends it towards cover.
Another defensive stroke to end the over. Length ball that holds its line without doing much.
Shorter length and defended by the leftie staying back in his crease.
Back to the line just outside off, slower through the air this time. Shaun comes ahead and pushes the ball back to the bowler.
Well outside off and Marsh pads this away.
Outside off and quicker, Marsh comes ahead and guides it with soft hands wide of slip for an easy couple of runs.
Fuller in length and on the sticks, Marsh pushes it away to mid-wicket.
Length ball at the pads, worked away towards the square leg fielder.
This one is wide outside off and the ball goes on a couple of bounces to the keeper as it does not rise at all. Head leaves it alone.
Length delivery on off, pushed away towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
FOUR! The ball is short, wide and outside off, Head immediately pounces on the width available as he cuts this beautifully wide of gully and all the way to fence. Safe shot that. Looked real good.
Shorter length, pushed in the gap wide of mid off by the southpaw. The batsmen come back for two.
Length ball outside off, Head keeps it out towards cover.
Jasprit Bumrah has come on for another spell.
Marsh comes slightly ahead and dead-bats this flatter delivery on off.
Flatter delivery, kept out off the back foot by the batsman.
Shorter one outside off, punched towards cover for a single by Head.
Marsh gets a quick single wide of mid on as he comes down the track and drives this flatter one.
Shorter one outside off, pushed to mid-wicket.
Just behind the rough outside the left-hander's off stump. Marsh pushes it back to the bowler.
Coming in at first but then going away late, full in length on off. Marsh plays it off the outer half past gully for a single.
A beautiful punch off the back foot. Head stands tall and times it well through the covers. Jadeja chases it down and keeps the batsmen to three.
Shaping away from a good length outside off, Head rises on his toes before tapping it down on the off side.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Too straight in line, worked wide of short mid-wicket for a brace.
Length delivery on off stump, Head gets behind the line and defends.
Fuller length ball outside off, Marsh takes a couple of strides down before blocking the ball.
On the pads, flicked away wristily towards the square leg fielder.
The batsman has played this flatter one outside off to the point region. They pick up a single.
Fuller outside off, defended by Travis coming ahead.

Loud appeal from India but the umpire is unmoved. This one rears off a length and turns back in, flicks the pads of Head who is looking to defend. The ball lobs up to leg slip and the fielders appeal but there was no bat involved there.

NOT OUT! The ball is outside off on a length and Head who comes ahead to drive misses the ball. Slightly drags his foot outside the crease, but brings it back in time. Pant whips off the bails a little late and Head is safe.
The square leg umpire has gone upstairs for a stumping appeal against Head. The batsman doesn't seem too worried though.
On a length, aimed at the hips. Worked away to square leg.
Shortens the length, Shaun flicks it away off the back foot in the gap through square leg for a couple.

FOUR! Where is the slip? Three down and India could have had another if there was a second slip in place. The length delivery outside off, takes a genuine edge as Marsh tries to defend the ball. It flies through the gap between first slip and gully for a boundary.
Another one towards the pads, Head flicks it away to deep fine leg for another single.
On the pads, worked away for a single wristily towards square leg.
Short length ball, Marsh is slightly ahead to defend this one that keeps a bit low.
Ishant Sharma is back on, replacing Mohammed Shami.
Goes for the sweep, gets hit on the pad again but the leg is well outside the line of the stumps here.
A watchful defensive stroke onto the ground by Head this time.

FOUR! The umpire signals runs off the bat. That would go down as a chance gone begging then! Absolute peach by Jadeja, Head plays for the turn and seems to have missed the ball. Pant too misses it and the ball runs away for a boundary. Bamboozled everyone that ball. Could have been interesting had the keeper taken that one.
Outside off on a fuller length, pushes it to mid-wicket once more, this time off the front foot.
Slightly short again, Travis pushes the ball to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball on a short length outside off, Head stays tall and pushes it back.
Mixing up the lengths here, back to a fuller one to end the over. The batsman pushes it to mid on.
Slightly short of a length, aimed at the pads. Marsh flicks it to backward square leg.
Length ball angling in from off again, the southpaw drives it towards mid on. His bat almost got stuck behind his front pad there.
Back to the line outside off, Marsh keeps it out with soft hands towards the slip cordon.
Fuller and angling down the pads, Shaun flicks it away square on the leg side for a couple.
Wide outside off, left alone by Marsh.
Another appeal! The ball has gripped and turned as Head tried to paddle sweep this one but missed. The umpire said no, most probably because the impact was outside off.
This time the ball is fuller and flicked away square on the leg side. Three runs result.
Outside off on a length, left alone by Marsh.
Shorter one outside off, Marsh stays tall and pushes it out towards mid on.
Grip and turn again! Beats the inside half of the bat and gets Marsh on the pads but the impact is outside off clearly.
Flatter one on off, played back to the bowler by Marsh.
Flicked away towards the square leg fielder in the circle to end the over.
Length ball on off, defended easily this time.
Bouncer! Well-aimed and Head does well to move out of the way at the last moment.
Back to a fuller length on middle, Marsh gets to the other end by flicking it wide of mid on.
On a length and keeps slightly low. Marsh does well to stay low and keep it out from within the crease.
Fuller and on middle, flicked straight towards the short mid-wicket fielder.
A watchful defensive stroke from Head brings an end to the over.
Travis Head comes in at number 5, replacing Usman Khawaja.

OUT! That's the third one! And it is the big fish. Absolute ripper this from Jadeja! Flatter ball outside off and Khawaja is forward in defense. The rough has been spotted by Jadeja and there was an explosion as the ball pitched. The ball grips and turns to get the inside edge and goes straight to Mayank Agarwal at short leg who takes a smart, low catch. Seemed like the batsman went with pretty hard hands there and that's caused the ball to carry easily to short leg. The Indians are turning on the heat here.

FOUR! The reverse sweep comes out! Flatter ball outside off, Khawaja gets to the pitch of the ball and places it fine on the off side for a boundary. Good shot against the turn. Ishant at backward point has to go and fetch the ball. The 50 comes up for Australia.
Usman comes down the track and blocks the ball.
Flatter ball again, Marsh comes down the track and pushes the ball wide of mid on. Gets to the other end.
Flatter outside off, Khawaja pushes it towards point and gets a single.
Shorter outside off, Marsh guides it down towards third man.
Just outside off, Usman drops this on off and sets off for a quick single. The mid off fielder picks up the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Marsh puts in a dive and gets in.
FOUR! Overpitched and dispatched away beautifully behind square on the leg side for a boundary. The outfield might be slow but the timing was so good that fine leg had no chance to stop it.
Short delivery, pulled away by Khawaja for a couple to deep square leg. The ball was not that far away from Mayank Agarwal at backward short leg.
Left alone outside off this time.
Length ball on off stump, Khawaja stands tall and defends back to the bowler.

Drinks are on the field. A good first hour for India. The pacers have done their job, with Ishant and Bumrah dismissing Finch and Harris respectively. You could consider Finch to be a bit unlucky, but Harris basically threw his wicket away. Big job ahead for Khawaja and Marsh now, as the ball is turning and Jadeja could capitalize on the rough areas.
Tossed up and just outside off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Keeps low. It's quicker through the air outside off, Marsh just about manages to defend it off the toe end.
Off the rough. The length and line both are perfect. Jadeja slows it up and floats it around off, it lands and turns in, goes off the pad on the off side as Marsh comes forward to defend.
Lands it on a driving length, around off, it spins in and Marsh blocks it well.
Quite full again, just outside off, it's driven to mid off from the front foot.
Full on middle and off, driven to mid on for nothing.
Spin introduced. Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack.
Full outside off, it's tapped down in front of short cover from inside the crease.
Comfortably left alone. On the fifth stump line, the batter doesn't bother himself with it.
Shortish delivery on off, the batsman is a bit cramped for room and the ball climbs on him quickly. He still takes the pull on and mistimes it towards mid on.
Angles the length ball in on off, Usman stays perfectly behind the line and meets it with a straight bat.
Keeps low and zips through. Khawaja will feel lucky that wasn't in line with the stumps. Outside off on a length, it goes under the bat as he tries to play at it.
Starts off from around the wicket and pitches a length delivery around off, Khawaja lets it go.
Mohammed Shami is the first bowling change for India.
Full ball around the off stump, driven right back at the bowler.
Bouncer angling in on middle and leg, the left-hander has nothing to do with it.
Bumrah switches the angle and comes from around the wicket, lands it on a length outside off. It keeps a little low but Marsh is watchful as he leaves it alone.
Leg slip in place.
Touch straight in line, clipped down easily on the leg side for no run.
Angling across from middle and off, Marsh positions himself well behind the line and blocks it.
A harmless length delivery outside off, Shaun Marsh lets it be.

Sharma is lucky that ball didn't race away to the fence. Was quite poor really. It's served wide outside off and too full in length, Khawaja reaches out and makes good connection, but hits it too close to the cover-point fielder who's able to dive to his left and stop it.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Zips off the deck, on a good length and well outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
FOUR! That's a positive stroke from Usman Khawaja. It's too full with room on offer outside off, he crashes this through the covers and finds the fence with ease.
Hurled on the fifth stump line, arms are shouldered to this one.
That wasn't far away at all. Sheesh! Nips back in from a length around off, Khawaja raises his bat to leave it and the ball whizzes past the off stump. Inches wide. A little too close for comfort.
It stays a touch low, just outside off, blocked carefully to end a successful over from Jasprit Bumrah.
Angling across on a good length, Marsh defends it down from within his crease.

Loud shout for a leg before, but nothing from the umpire. Clearly pitched outside leg and there was an inside edge as well, so Marsh would have been saved anyhow. Bumrah with a length ball which goes on middle, takes the edge and thuds Marsh on the pads.
Shaun Marsh comes in next to bat.

OUT! Throws it away really. Was no need for that shot. Sucked him in and got the wicket. Well done on India's part, quite the contrary on Marcus Harris'. Poor shot selection. He's frustrated with himself, and should be too. Short ball from around the wicket, angling in on middle and leg, Harris takes on the pull and is in no control of that shot. Fine leg is positioned specifically for this, and it's a straightforward catch to Ishant Sharma out in the deep as the ball goes off the top edge. Both the Australian openers are back in the dressing room now.
FOUR! Spills it on the pads Bumrah pays the price for it. Harris just moves inside the line and helps it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Too straight in line, and the length ball is wristed through backward square leg. Two runs to end the over as fine leg cuts it off moving to his right.
Drags his length slightly short, keeps it around off, the Australian no.3 hangs back inside the crease and taps it down on the off side.
Short ball which is rising, outside off, Khawaja initially thinks of taking the pull on but then withdraws at the last second.
Bit fullish in length, around off this time, it's defended right under his eye-line.
Swerving in on the off stick, Usman remains watchful as he presents a straight bat in defense.
Continues from around the wicket too, it's a length ball shaping in on off, Usman Khawaja defends with the full face.
Good length ball on middle and leg, worked away to the man at short leg.
Bumper on middle and off, comfortably ducked under by the opener.
Keeps low again as it's angling in on middle and leg, worked off the pads down towards fine leg for one.

Just ahead of a length, in line of the stumps and this is what's needed more from the Indian pacers. Khawaja defends this, but the ball keeps low. Had the batsman missed, he would have been plumb for sure. Challenge for the batsmen too, it's not going to be easy out there.
Taps this to cover-point and scurries through for a run.
Length ball which moves away off the seam, Harris plays it off the outer half past gully and down towards third man for a single.
Off the mark. Khawaja nicely tucks this away off his pads behind square on the leg side. Big gap out there, so he's able to take a double.
Fuller again, around that off stump, Khawaja is solid in defense.
Full delivery swinging back in from around off, Khawaja brings down a straight bat and keeps it out.
Usman Khawaja walks in at no.3.

OUT! Got 'em! The first casualty is down for Australia. And what a catch from Mayank Agarwal at short mid-wicket. Good captaincy from Virat Kohli to bring in that catching fielder. It made Ishant bowl straighter and get the result. Full on middle, coming in slightly, Finch flicks this aerially. Agarwal at short mid-wicket dives quick and dives low to his left to pull off an absolute blinder. Good work from the debutant. Looks like the Indians have done their homework as they have noticed a weakness in Finch's shots through mid-wicket that he fails to keep them down. This was seen in the UAE as well. A welcome wicket for the visitors, as both openers were looking confident, so they needed to get a breakthrough quickly.
Tight line again. Finch can only defend this length delivery around off just ahead of him.
On a length on the fourth stump line, Finch comes half-forward and pushes it towards Jadeja at short cover.
Another two, nicely done. It's full and angling in on middle and leg, Harris flicks it through the big gap in the mid-wicket area.
A little too full outside off, Harris drives it past cover-point and manages to come back for the second.
Fraction straight in line, easy enough for the left-handed opener to work it down on the leg side.
Brings out the short one, on middle stump, Marcus ducks and evades.
Almost dragged it on. Bumrah brings it in slightly closer to off, Harris plays at it and ends up getting an inside edge which goes past the pads and towards short leg.

That's a good leave. Bumrah serves it in the channel outside off, Harris lets it be. Earlier in Perth, he had left a similar ball and got bowled as a result. He and Bumrah will both be aware of that fact.
Aaron takes a big lunge ahead and defensively punches it in front of covers.

Beaten! Good comeback from Sharma, absolute peach. Keeps it just outside off, it nips away ever so slightly and it almost undoes Finch. It goes past the outside edge of his hanging bat and thuds into the keeper's gloves.

FOUR! That is a beautiful, confident shot from Aaron Finch. No swing in the air at all, Ishant just hangs it in the air outside off. Finch takes a stride forward and caresses the drive through the covers for a boundary.
Bit fuller than the previous delivery, wide outside off though. An easy leave for the batsman.
Brings it in closer, a length ball around off, makes Finch play at it which is what he should be doing. The opener comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Too far outside off, close to the tramline, Aaron Finch has nothing to do with it.
Harris slightly opens the face and dabs this fuller delivery away on the off side.
Full in length, quite close to off, it's played back in the bowler's direction.
FOUR! First of the morning. Good shot from Marcus Harris. He has some room on offer outside off, just waits for it, uses the pace and with his fast hands cuts it past gully for a boundary.
Full on this occasion, Harris gets low and drills it straight to the cover fielder.
Just behind a good length, outside the line of off stump, it's pushed away to the off side with gentle hands.
Bumrah too comes around the wicket, angles in a length ball on off, Harris stays inside the crease and blocks it out.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Hurls it in the off stump channel, the batsman covers the line and shoulders arms to it.
Nicely timed. Marcus Harris offers the full face of the bat as he times the drive past mid on. Gets a single for doing so.
Around the wicket to Harris, it's a length ball tailing in on the pads, the southpaw works it down in front of the square leg fielder.
Just ahead of a length, outside off, Finch offers a punchy-drive through the covers and takes a single. First runs of the morning for Finch.
Full and just outside off, Finch plants his front foot forward and mistimes the drive to short cover.
Over the wicket now to Finch. It's a length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, left alone by the batsman.

No ball! Bit of a false start. Comes from around the wicket to Harris, angles it in on middle and leg, the left-hander clips it off his pads and works it down to fine leg for a single. Ishant overstepped on this occasion, so a no ball is signalled.

Time to begin. As the Indian team is in a huddle by the boundary line, the Australian openers Marcus Harris and Aaron Finch stride out to the middle. Ishant Sharma will be handed the ball first up. Two Slips and a gully in position for him. Let's roll...

Mark Howard has Rohit Sharma with him for an interview just besides the Indian Team which is undergoing a few fielding drills. Rohit says that the drills that are going on are regarding the position of the slips and close-in fielders, considering the low carry on the surface. He also adds that the back injury he had in the previous game has completely sorted itself and he is 100% now. Ends by saying that the on-field banter was a lot of fun but when he is in the middle, he tends to concentrate on his batting.

That said, a lot would be expected of the two Victorian opening batsmen, especially Marcus Harris with the good form he is in. The middle order comes into the game with some confidence but, will their being on the field for almost two days have an effect on them? So many possibilities! A long haul from the Australian batsmen with a toil for the Indian bowlers or, A great bowling performance running through the hosts order? What are we about to witness? Or will it be a neck and neck day ? Whatever it is, the day has to be exciting, or at least promises to be so. Lets wait and watch!

Hello and welcome to what promises to be an exciting day of Test cricket from the MCG. Day 3 of the 3rd Test of the Border-Gavaskar Trophy is nicely poised and it'll be interesting to see how the day pans out. Australia have their work cut out to bat and bat long. They have the threat of the pitch that has started to play tricks and an Indian bowling unit that is in good form to contend with. A certain Jasprit Bumrah and Ravindra Jadeja should most probably be their biggest fear on a surface with variable bounce.
... Third Day, Morning Session ...

Day 3 is going to be a big one. The surface is still good for batting for the most part, but it's turning now and the variable bounce is causing problems too, as we saw earlier in the Indian innings. It'll be a different challenge for both sides. The action begins at 1030 local (2330 GMT, Previous Day). Join in for that. Till then, you can switch tabs and catch all the action from Day 2 of the ongoing SA-PAK Test and the Big Bash match between Sydney Sixers and Melbourne Stars beginning in some time. Cheers!

Just 6 overs were possible, but plenty of action in them. India would have liked a wicket or two, Ishant, Bumrah and Jadeja all applied the pressure, especially Bumrah, but it didn't happen as Finch and Harris somehow managed to survive. India declared after posting 443/7 on the board, and that came after a lot of hard work. A good start from the openers, Pujara's resilience, Kohli's class, followed by Rohit and Pant's free-flowing hitting got the visitors there.

Edged but just short! Bumrah lands it outside off, Finch plays at this with soft hands and that's what saves him. It goes on the bounce to Virat Kohli at third slip, who dives to his right and stops it. So this pair survives, it's STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Bumper on middle and leg, Harris fends it away past short leg and gets to the other end.
Short of a good length on off stump, Harris stays perfectly behind the line and defends.
Keeps a little low and almost goes through. Bumrah angles it in on off, Finch is nearly undone by the lack of bounce as it goes off the inner half and past the leg stump. A single is taken.
Fullish and angling in on the pads, flicked away in front of square leg for an easy run. He'll be relieved to get off strike.

Beaten! Beautiful bowling. At 148 kph, Bumrah pitches it on a length on off. It comes in first, then moves away ever so late. Beats the outside edge of Marcus Harris' bat and goes to Rishabh Pant behind.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller ball in line of the stumps, Finch comes half-forward to keep it out.
Finch comes forward, it's quicker in pace, blocked with the full face.
Spinning away from outside off, tapped to point with an open face.
Full outside off, Finch drives it to the man at mid off.
Full and straight, on the stumps, driven back in the bowler's direction.
Ravindra Jadeja is called into the attack.
Pushes this fuller length ball towards mid on. The batsmen want a single but then decide against it.
Nicely done. Harris presents a tight defensive shot. Keeps his bat close to his body and blocks this length ball out.
Stays inside the crease and defends this one out with a straight bat.

That was close! Almost dragged it back on to the stumps. Bumrah bowls it full just outside off and Harris looks to play with a straight bat. It takes the toe end, bounce behind and goes over the stumps. How fortunate for the opener.
We have a slight halt in play as the physio is out to have a look at Marcus Harris. He seemed fine, and should be okay to continue as well. But a quick scan wouldn't hurt anyone.
Nasty! A sharp and accurate bouncer from Bumrah catches Harris on the helmet as he looks to duck under it. He quickly takes his helmet off, the Indian players walk up to check on him.
Bumrah switches to around the wicket and almost gets his man. Lands it outside off and it jags away with some extra bounce. Harris fishes inside the line and almost edges it.
Decent carry on this. Good length delivery in the off stump channel, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Makes him play this time. Pitches it fuller and close to off, Finch meets it with the full face of the bat.
Needs to bring it in closer. On the sixth stump line, Aaron lets it be.
Hurled too far outside off, the right-hander has nothing to do with it.
Angling down the leg side, Finch looks to flick but misses.

Dear me! That is a brave leave, to say the least. Ishant serves a length delivery around off and it jags back in off the seam. Finch points his bat skywards as the ball whiskers past the off pole. Don't think even he thought it'd go past that close.
Full delivery just outside off, Harris drives this past the mid off fielder. A couple of runs result.
Finch is looking a little edgy. Once again the inswing almost gets him. He pushes away from his body and gets it off the inside edge down to fine leg for one.
Bumrah hits the deck hard and angles it in on a back of a length on off. Finch hops a little and guards it out safely.
Short of a good length into the body, Finch rises on his toes and defends it back down the track.
Keeps a little low as it's pitched on a back of a length, Finch rocks back to pull but it goes off the under edge and thuds onto his thigh pad.
Darts a length ball on off stump, angling in, Finch defends it with the full face of the bat.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.

Nearly... nearly. Significant movement back in from around off, on a length, Finch just about manages to work it to backward square leg somehow. A single is taken. End of an eventful first over from Ishant.
Too far outside off, another leave is made by the batsman.
Length ball in the off stump channel, Finch covers the line and shoulders arms.

Oh! How close was that? Incredible start from Ishant Sharma. He lands it on a length and brings this one back in to Aaron Finch. The batsman looks to play at it and gets it off the inner half on the leg side.
Sprays it on the hips, Harris clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Movement straightaway. Ishant lands it on off, it comes in at first and then moves away. Marcus Harris is squared up as he looks to defend and gets beaten.
